question: The latent heat of fusion of ice is _____ kJ/kg.
solution:
The correct answer is __336**(kJ/kg)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Latent heat of fusion__ is the heat energy required to change a substance from solid to liquid at a constant temperature.
 
• For ice, the latent heat of fusion is 336 kJ/kg.
 
• This means 336 kJ of energy is needed to convert 1 kg of ice into water without changing its temperature.
 
• It is a characteristic property of the material and is crucial in thermodynamics and phase change studies.
